question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
-- Build the full query for top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_matches_count AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pmc.matches_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0), 2) AS batting_avg
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN player_matches_count pmc ON pr.player_id = pmc.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build the full query for top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_matches_count AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pmc.matches_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0), 2) AS batting_avg
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN player_matches_count pmc ON pr.player_id = pmc.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5", "preview_rows": 10}
